content.title: EV maker VinFast's quarterly loss widens on hefty spending
content.summary:
STORY: VinFast reported a bigger net loss in the third quarter on Friday (November 21).

It comes after the electric vehicle maker spent heavily to boost sales and expand.

The loss widened to $910.85 million - significantly up from a year ago.

The automaker signed two loan facilities during the period totaling $250 million.

The Vietnamese company wants to grow internationally despite tariff pressures and low-key demand in the U.S.

But some analysts believe taking on more debt could hit the loss-making firm's margins while it also works hard to cut costs.

One market watcher said VinFast has shifted its focus from the U.S. and Europe to other Asian markets.

But added it faces similar challenges competing with Tesla and Chinese EVs.

However, revenues for the quarter were around $687 million - that's up almost 47% from last year.

E-scooter and e-bike deliveries soared more than six-fold during the period.

Shares of the company were down more than 5% in premarket trading.
